CATEGORY 1 – WEEK 1 (27.10.2026 to 31.10.2026)
Paper 1 – BNSS: Introduction (Sections 1–3), Chapter 1 (Sections 1–5) – Definitions, Chapter 2 (Sections 6, 8, 14), Chapter 3 (Sections 21–23) – Constitution of Criminal Courts and Offices, Structure of Criminal Courts, Public Prosecutor (PP) and District Public Prosecutor (DOP).

Paper 3 – Central Minor Acts and Special Laws: The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 (Sections 1–9, 24, 27, 31 and 35), Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 (Sections 1–4), Indecent Representation of Women (Prohibition) Act, 1986 (Sections 3, 4, 6 and 8), Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (Sections 1–10) and Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956 (Sections 1–9, 14 and 15).

Paper 8 – Police Organisation and Administration: Origin, History and Evolution of Police in India, Relation with Neighbouring Countries and Border Issues, Central Police Organisations (I.B., C.B.I., C.R.P.F., B.S.F., I.T.B.P., R.P.F., C.I.S.F., N.C.B., N.C.R.B., N.I.A., S.S.B., R.A.W., Assam Rifles, B.P.R. and D., N.P.A., C.D.T.S., N.I.C.F.S., Central Forensic Science Laboratory, Central Finger Print Bureau, Army, Navy, Air Force, N.C.C., Rashtriya Raksha Shakti University and National Forensic Science University), Organisational Structure of State Police (D.G.P., Range, Commissionerate, District, Sub-Division, Circle, Police Station, Chowki and Outpost), Functioning of Various Branches of Police (C.P./S.P. Office, Reader Branch, Special Branch/L.I.B., P.C.B., D.C.B./L.C.B., Police Headquarter, Traffic Police, Women Police Station, Coastal Police Station, Wireless, M.O.B., M.T. and S.O.G.) and Modification as per State Police Organisation/Structure.

Paper 12 – B. Accountability: Constitutional Values, Rule of Law and Role of Police, Preamble of Indian Constitution, Democratic Republic, Sovereign, Socialist, Secular and Federal State of India, Spirit of Indian Constitution – Part III (Articles 12–35) and Fundamental Rights.
